''Yes'' value activates the simplified UI of the PayPal Dispute page, namely search dispute section and dispute history will be hidden. In this case, PayPal disputes will not be stored on the Demandware side, and also, PayPal disputes will be retrieved and updated from PayPal in real-time by using dispute API. ''No" Value activates the full functionality of the Dispute page, namely search dispute section and dispute history will be shown, but in this case PayPal disputes will be stored in the objects on the Demandware side and will be retrieved and updated via PayPal Dispute webhooks.
